items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: And Stan was here, I went over to see him

ctx.x: Well, I don't have anything against Los Angeles, except that I have no base of operations there anymore.

I've got the place here in San Diego and the boat, and I've got my home in Palm Springs and this is just fine, because we get the same bands here in San Diego that appear in Los Angeles, and they're a lot more accessible here. Like Stan Kenton has been here, and Woody Herman, Harry James, Count Basie. They had Count Basie playing out at the ballpark here one year. He played for three days, before the game. And in between innings. And I sat right down there, with the band in front of me, and it was just wonderful.…
Well, the expense of transporting a band.
